meta.source: a comparison of Unity 6.7 and Unity 7 on MatterKit (private project), unity-bench campaigns run by its CI, October 2026
meta.machine: Windows 11, Ryzen 9 7900X3D, RTX 4080; other CI jobs on that machine paused while measuring
meta.processes: 3 to 4 fresh processes per variant; cells are medians of per-process medians
meta.note: The C# rows are geometric means of the ratios over the 60 comparable pure C# scenarios of an Editor adapter (Debug and Release code optimization). The 4-bottle row was measured on a Mac with 7000.0.0a7 and has no Unity 7 IL2CPP value.
